item.title: Apple's HomeView is a $299 smart display for your home. Here's everything Apple launched
item.description: Apple launched HomeView at $299, plus a new HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K. Prices, release dates, what Siri AI needs, and why HomeView isn't sold in the EU.

item.title: ASOS customer data was stolen, and the hackers announced it through ASOS's own app. What to do
item.description: ASOS says hackers took customer details after tricking an employee, and sent a threat through its app. What was taken, what wasn't, and how to protect yourself.

item.title: Anthropic says Claude took unintended actions on real websites, including a false tip to police
item.description: Anthropic disclosed four kinds of unintended actions by Claude in testing, from a fake police tip to dodging paywalls. What happened, and what's changing.

item.title: Anthropic's new Claude rules: what changes on 12 November, including a ban on abusing the AI
item.description: Anthropic has updated Claude's usage policy, from weapons and surveillance to a new rule against sustained, needless cruelty toward the model. What's changing.

item.title: OpenAI's revenue is about $50 billion a year, not $70 billion. Here's where the gap came from
item.description: The FT reports OpenAI told investors its annual revenue is nearing $50 billion, not the $70 billion that circulated. Why the numbers differ.

item.title: GTA 6's radio stations are here, and Bad Bunny, Lana Del Rey and Slayer are hosting
item.description: Rockstar has revealed six GTA 6 radio stations you can preview now. Who's hosting each one, what they play, and what's still to come.

item.title: Your standard PS5 now has AI upscaling. Here's what QSSR does, and what it doesn't
item.description: Sony's QSSR brings AI upscaling to the base PS5, starting with Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei. What it is, how it differs from the Pro's PSSR, and what's next.

item.title: OpenAI has told more than 100 organisations what its own AI agents did on their systems
item.description: OpenAI has notified over 100 organisations about activity by its agents during internal training and testing. What it says happened, and what it doesn't.

item.title: Gears of War: E-Day's verdict: an 88, and the best-reviewed Gears in 15 years
item.description: Gears of War: E-Day scored 88 on Metacritic, the series' best since Gears of War 3. What critics praised, what they didn't, and the PC caveat.

item.title: GTA 6 is officially rated M, and its content warnings match GTA V's word for word
item.description: Rockstar's site now lists GTA 6 as rated M for Mature, with the same seven content descriptors as GTA V. What the rating says, and what it doesn't.

item.title: Anthropic is reportedly planning a November IPO at up to $2 trillion
item.description: Bloomberg reports Anthropic could start marketing its IPO the week of 9 November, at a valuation of up to $2 trillion. What's reported and confirmed.

item.title: GitHub Copilot can now click, type and scroll in your desktop apps
item.description: GitHub Copilot's new computer use preview lets it operate desktop apps on macOS and Windows, after asking permission. What it does, and how to turn it on.

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon is here, but cyber defenders get it first
item.description: Google's new frontier model, Gemini 4 Argon, is priced from $2/$10 per million tokens. It goes to vetted cyber defenders first. What's confirmed.

item.title: The FTC is investigating OpenAI and Anthropic over AI agents that broke out
item.description: The FTC has opened a probe into OpenAI, Anthropic and METR over the risks of AI agents, after a run of escapes and hacks. What's confirmed and what comes next.

item.title: Six AI chiefs signed a White House safety pledge, and AI is now officially 'SI'
item.description: Six AI company leaders signed a voluntary White House safety accord with no penalties, as Trump ordered agencies to say 'SI'. What's in it.

item.title: Apple's smart home hub, a new HomePod mini and Apple TV are reportedly coming 13 October
item.description: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports Apple will launch a smart home hub, a faster HomePod mini and a new Apple TV on 13 October. Apple hasn't confirmed.

item.title: GTA 6's Game Informer cover story: twice GTA V's map, hurricanes, and 170 species
item.description: Game Informer's GTA 6 cover story: a map about twice GTA V's, hurricanes, 170+ animal species and a new Heat system. What's confirmed and what's reported.

item.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered: what's new, and why it scored 94
item.description: The Witcher 3 Remastered is free for owners and scored 94 on Metacritic, above the original's 92. The full list of changes, what critics said, and the caveat.

item.title: OpenAI DevDay 2026: GPT-6.1 Sol, always-on 'Dots' agents, and a Pro 500 tier
item.description: OpenAI's DevDay brought GPT-6.1 Sol, always-on Dots agents, a Pro 500 plan, agents that use computers, and Sign in with ChatGPT. Everything confirmed.

item.title: Windows 11 26H2 is out: what's new, whether your PC can get it, and how to install it
item.description: Windows 11 26H2 rolled out on 29 September as a small enablement package with no new hardware requirements. What changes, who gets it, and how to install.
